facts.fact: El Khabar reports that digital services have run on the national Fada El Djazair platform since 14 March 2024, including a pilot of online cadastral extracts.
El Khabar reports that nearly 7 million users have been served through Fada El Djazair since its launch on 14 March 2024.

note: No single sign-in or count of services is stated.
